cards.back: National Master Plan (2021) for multimodal connectivity — a digital platform integrating 16 ministries for coordinated infrastructure planning, reducing logistics costs (target: <10% of GDP).

cards.front: Who publishes: Human Development Index, Global Hunger Index, Ease of Doing Business?
cards.back: HDI — UNDP; GHI — Concern Worldwide & Welthungerhilfe; Ease of Doing Business — World Bank (discontinued 2021, replaced by Business Ready/B-READY).

cards.front: What were the key outcomes of India's G20 Presidency (2023)?
cards.back: New Delhi Leaders' Declaration (consensus), African Union's permanent G20 membership, India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC), Global Biofuel Alliance, Digital Public Infrastructure framework.

cards.front: What are the key provisions of the Women's Reservation Act (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam), 2023?
cards.back: 106th Constitutional Amendment: 33% reservation for women in Lok Sabha, State Assemblies and Delhi Assembly; to take effect after the delimitation following the first census post-enactment; 15-year initial period.

cards.front: What is the PLI (Production Linked Incentive) scheme?
cards.back: Incentives (4–6% of incremental sales) to boost domestic manufacturing across 14 sectors (electronics, pharma, solar, semiconductors...) — aims at scale, exports, and Atmanirbhar Bharat.

cards.front: What is the significance of India joining the Artemis Accords?
cards.back: Signed 2023 — non-binding principles (NASA-led) for peaceful, transparent lunar/space exploration cooperation; opens avenues for ISRO-NASA collaboration (e.g., NISAR satellite, astronaut training).

cards.front: Which organisations publish the World Economic Outlook and the Global Financial Stability Report?
cards.back: Both by the IMF (biannual). The World Bank publishes the Global Economic Prospects; WEF publishes the Global Competitiveness and Global Gender Gap reports.

cards.front: What are the three new criminal laws replacing IPC, CrPC and the Evidence Act (2023)?
cards.back: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (replaces IPC), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (CrPC), Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (Evidence Act) — effective 1 July 2024; add community service, e-FIR, timelines for investigation.

cards.front: What is BIMSTEC and its members?
cards.back: Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (1997, HQ Dhaka): Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Thailand — bridge between South and Southeast Asia.

Lifestyle for Environment — launched by India at COP26/Kevadia (2022): global mass movement nudging individual & community climate-friendly behaviours ('pro-planet people'), part of India's NDC commitments.
